response.note: Finds the acquirer with the most September technical failures (assuming failure_category value 'technical' denotes technical failures) and lists its failures by date and hour, top 50 by count.
response.sql: SELECT acquirer_name, txn_date, hour_of_day, COUNT(*) AS technical_failures FROM v_attempts_clean WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01' AND failure_category = 'technical' AND acquirer_name = (SELECT acquirer_name FROM v_attempts_clean WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01' AND failure_category = 'technical' GROUP BY acquirer_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY acquirer_name, txn_date, hour_of_day ORDER BY technical_failures DESC LIMIT 50
